entries.en: memory; to recite from memory, to say by heart
memory, the faculty of remembering
entries.notes: R 栏『hiam』与『记性』音不合，疑串栏；释义依 H『记性』与 M kì-sìnn 定。

entries.en: memory, recollection; a remembrance
a firm, retentive memory that does not change
entries.notes: H 第二字作『带』于义罕见，义依 L 全句 memoria fija, no se muda 定。

entries.zh: 牢记，记得牢；顽固的记忆
entries.en: a tenacious, firmly fixed memory
a memorial (petition) submitted to a mandarin or Chinese official

entries.zh: 呈给上级的呈文（字面『降书』，卑辞上呈之书）
entries.en: a memorial or petition submitted to a superior; a letter of submission
entries.notes: L『memorial del superior』可解作上呈或下达，H『降书』取卑辞投呈之义，故存两可。

entries.en: to beg, to go begging; to ask, to request
entries.notes: 汉文、音写、对音三栏皆空，仅存西语词头，无汉文互证。

entries.en: to shake, to sway, to rock; to move
entries.notes: H 作『搔[疑:搖]』，M 记 iâu／iô 两读，正合『摇』字文白异读，故定为摇动。

entries.en: to move, to stir
entries.notes: M 栏于『动』文白二读（tǎng／tǒng）之后杂入『tǔy tǎng mǔnasre』，疑串行掺入，取前二读。

entries.zh: 摆手，甩手（如抖袖般挥动手）
entries.en: to move or wave the hand, as in shaking out a sleeve
entries.notes: 『como la manga』句意晦，H『託』与 M tô 难与手势义确对，释义存疑。

entries.en: to flap the wings rapidly
entries.notes: H『習』于此义罕用，疑为借音字；义依 L『menear las alas apriessa』定。

entries.zh: 挪动身子；露身（L 句『en mudo』费解）
entries.en: to stir oneself, to move about; to show oneself (Spanish phrase obscure)
entries.notes: L 句费解，H『露』与 M lǒu 仅能定『露身／动身』大意，确切语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 露出身体，赤身；扭动身子
entries.en: to bare the body; to move one's body
entries.notes: H『露体』与 M lǒu tây 相合，惟与 L『menearse』语义稍隔，故降一等。

entries.en: the body
entries.notes: R 栏原作 cuerpo，与 H『身体』、M sīn tây 互证，故定为名词『身体』。

entries.zh: 在椅上坐不安稳，扭来扭去
entries.en: to fidget, to squirm on a chair
entries.notes: L『el fanda』费解（疑为 falda），H『病[疑:著/箸]』与 M pē guîo 均难确解。

entries.en: to turn oneself round, to rotate
to move to and fro, to shift about
to move by pulling; to jerk, to tug
to shake one's head in mockery
entries.notes: H 作『差[疑:搓]頭』，M 记 lǎu-thâu，字形与音写均不无疑，义依 L 定。
